keyFindings.description: Architect's ruling. A Retry (POST /api/v1/comments/{id}/deliveries) while attempt 1 is queued opens attempt 2 (claimCommentDeliveryAttempt's default branch, :311-316); when attempt 2 fails, the lane's bound send of attempt 1 reads latest=false (MentionLatestAttemptSQL counts max(attempt) whatever its state), takes `case !latest` (:281-285) and supersedeCommentDelivery (:417-446) settles it failed and sends nothing. With no route, claimant, author or follower destination for the session, the outbox holds no copy, so the session never gets the comment. Base sent inside the request, so this is a regression. Same root: a keyed repeat or a sweep pass bound to an attempt a failed Retry overtook; a sender that dies after a failed Retry leaves attempt 1 pending and owed by nobody. A later attempt still in flight when the lane arrives, which then fails, loses it too. Fix: supersede only once a later attempt was sent (or keep the queued attempt and fail the Retry into it), keep the sweep's owed rule and the outbox's abandoned rule in step, and add a test that fails on e4846fb7: no route, the Retry fails while attempt 1 is queued, the session gets the comment once. Docs this makes false: comment_delivery.go:237-239 and 409-412, AGENTS.md:1427, changelog pr2406-Changed-20261028-113305.yaml:24-26.

The PR conflicts with main again: merge main forward (never a rebase). Main's outbox/publisher.go now adds quiet in envelope() and counts publish failures through Deps.countPublishFailure; the fallback pass's failure branches should count through it too.

Two doc sentences are false at head: model.go:1282-1284 says all three predicates turn on the lease through mentionAttemptPastClaimLapseSQL (MentionResumedSQL no longer uses it), and api/delivery_sweep.go:83-85 says the outbox holds a copy 'for exactly the attempts this sweep will send' (resumed now includes overtaken attempts a sender holds, which the sweep never sends).

A fallback pass after a scan that shutdown cut short now claims up to 100 rows only to fail loadFallbackEvents with context canceled and log an Error before releasing them; return before the claim when ctx is done.
